levels.surface: أبو الحسن أحمد بن محمد بن الحسن بن الوليد
أبي جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين

notes: «حدثني أبي» is a bare relation (father of the link before it); it is not named by the text, so it is not filled in.
The Imam is written inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator.
Abu Dhar is a figure in the story, not a link: the saying is the Imam's account of him.
The name stands twice in the chain as two different «حدثني» links; the repeated «أبي» is kept as two relation links.
